name: Murmliwasser & Murmlitrail Serfaus
kurzbeschreibung: The Murmliwasser at the Komperdellbahn in Serfaus at 1,980 m: 15,000 m² water adventure park featuring a marmot enclosure, gold panning site, and the Murmlitrail.
beschreibung:
Overview

The award-winning alpine water and adventure world Murmliwasser is located at the mid-station of the Komperdellbahn above the world-renowned family tourism resort of Serfaus in the Tyrolean Oberland (Landeck district) at an altitude of around 1,980 metres. Surrounded by the striking rocky peaks of the Samnaungruppe, the adventure park spans a gigantic, approximately 15,000-square-metre alpine meadow and river area. Named after the popular Serfaus mascot "Murmli", the park introduces children and parents to the habitat and habits of the alpine marmot, offering an incomparable combination of pristine mountain water, nature education, and alpine adventure.

Route & Requirements

The centrepiece of the complex is the sprawling water play park: a natural mountain stream feeds numerous sluice gates, waterwheels, scoop wheels, fountains, and dams where children can dam, redirect, and experiment with water to their hearts' content. An absolute highlight for little treasure hunters is the historic Murmli-Goldwaschanlage (gold panning site): using wooden pans, guests wash sparkling semi-precious stones and fool's gold (pyrite) from the river sand. Animal enthusiasts will marvel at the spacious live marmot enclosure: in a near-natural rocky landscape, genuine alpine marmots can be observed digging, playing, and basking in the sun. An underground, walk-through Murmeltierbau (marmot burrow) equipped with viewing windows takes visitors straight into the underground sleeping and living chambers of the rodents. Directly adjoining the park is the mystical Murmlitrail: a fairytale themed trail of around one kilometre, fully accessible for pushchairs, winding through an ancient Swiss stone pine forest where talking trees, a sleeping mother bear, and whimsical woodland creatures turn the hike into an enchanting adventure.

Visit & Arrival

The Murmliwasser and the Murmlitrail are open during the summer season from mid-June to mid-October daily from 08:30 to 17:00. Admission to the Murmliwasser grounds is free – visitors only require a cable car ticket up to the Komperdell mid-station. Summer 2025/2026 rates: ascent and descent Komperdellbahn adults approx. €26.50, children approx. €16.50, young children under 6 years ride free. Overnight guests in Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis receive the Super. Sommer. Card., with which all mountain railways and Murmliwasser can be used completely free of charge! Getting there by car: via the Inntalautobahn A12 or S16 expressway to Landeck, then continue on the B180 (Reschenstraße) to Ried im Oberinntal, where you branch off onto the Serfauser Landesstraße leading up to Serfaus (large free day-parking lots are located at the village entrance; Serfaus is a traffic-calmed resort). From there, the free underground U-Bahn Serfaus takes guests directly to the cable car valley station. By public transport: ÖBB train to Landeck-Zams railway station, from there take Postbus route 220 directly to Serfaus.

Tips

The modern Komperdellbahn and the main paths throughout Murmliwasser as well as the entire Murmlitrail are step-free, barrier-free, and excellently suited for prams and wheelchairs. Be sure to pack towels and spare clothes for children, as splashing in the mountain stream is virtually irresistible. Relax on the sunny panorama terraces of the surrounding mountain huts (such as the Lassida-Alm or the Restaurant Komperdell) with sweeping views of the Swiss alpine peaks.
